name: Body Adjustment
body:
Discipline psychometabolism (healing); Level cryptic 2, gifted blade 2, marksman 2, psion/wilder 3, psychic warrior 2, vitalist 2

MANIFESTING

Display Auditory and material
Manifesting Time 1 round

EFFECT

Range Personal
Target You
Duration Instantaneous
Power Points cryptic 3, gifted blade 3, marksman 3, psion/wilder 5, psychic warrior 3, vitalist 3

DESCRIPTION

You take control of your body’s healing process, curing yourself of 1d12 points of damage. As usual, when regular damage is healed, an equal amount of nonlethal damage is also healed.

Augment For every 2 additional power points you spend, this power heals an additional 1d12 points of damage.
